**Requirement:** State and explain the title of your senior comprehensive project.

## The title

> Replace this blockquote with the working title of your senior comprehensive
> project.

## What the title promises

Explain, in your own words, what a reader should expect that the project
delivers, based on the title alone. Address each part of the title separately:
the subject matter, the approach or intervention, and the expected outcome.

## What the title leaves out

Every title is a compression. Identify the scope, assumptions, or audiences that
the title does not convey and explain why they are omitted.

## Titles I considered and rejected

Describe at least two alternative titles and explain why you discarded them.
What did each alternative emphasize or overpromise?

## Reminders

- Use the same title here, on your research journal, and in `thesis/index.qmd`.
- Cite sources in ACM format whenever you refer to prior work by other
  researchers.
- Consult the course syllabus for the expected length and evaluation criteria.
